title: Flowers and Fruit

stage.name: Fruit tree
stage.description: Flowers became fruit. The seeds inside begin the cycle again.

intro: What you've grown starts to give back.

questions.prompt: What is the main job of a flower?

options: Moving pollen so seeds can form
questions.why: Bees, birds, bats or the wind carry pollen from flower to flower.

questions.prompt: Close the circle. Put the life cycle in order.
questions.why: And a seed in soil is where you began.

questions.prompt: What keeps a relationship fruitful for years?
options: Keep tending it: curiosity, gratitude and time together
Stop putting in effort once it's established
Expect it to stay the same forever
questions.why: Even a mature tree needs water. Lasting couples keep choosing each other.

talk: What fruit do you hope your relationship brings, to you and to the people around you?
